_description: Policy coverage lookup table. Given a policy_type and incident_category, returns coverage details.

basic_homeowner.notes: Basic coverage. Does not cover water damage, vandalism, or flood.

standard_homeowner.notes: Standard coverage. Does not cover flood or earthquake without separate rider.

premium_homeowner.notes: Comprehensive coverage. Flood and earthquake require separate rider but have reduced deductible.

renters.notes: Covers personal property only, not structural damage. Liability included.

landlord.notes: Covers structural damage and liability. Tenant belongings not covered.

usage: Lookup policy_type → check if incident_category is in covered_categories. Return { covered: bool, deductible, max_payout, notes }.
